newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil 1997 trade deficit forecast at $6.5 bln-CNI.
newsitem.headline: Brazil 1997 trade deficit forecast at $6.5 bln-CNI.

text.p: Brazil's trade deficit may reach $6.5 billion in 1997 against an estimated $5 billion in 1996, said Brazil's National Industry Confederation (CNI) in a forecast of the Brazilian economy for 1997.

The current account deficit is seen at 3.5 percent of the country's gross domestic product and inflation should be between six and eight percent next year against a forecast 10 percent in 1996, it said in a statement.

The CNI also estimated that Brazilian exports will reach $52 billion in 1997 against a forecast $48 billion in exports this year. Brazilian imports are expected to total $58.5 billion against $53 billion this year, it said.
-- Fatima Cristina, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
